peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 6.6% below its local comparables; 16 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (29.1): 2.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 24 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 66.7% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2000.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,180,000 ($1,154 psf, 1,022 sq ft; 5 resales, Oct 2024–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,236 psf (range $964–1,359); 6.6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $84,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Upper Changi MRT about 740 m, Tampines East MRT about 940 m; closer than 28 of 94 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest East Spring Primary School about 470 m; more than 19 of 94 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 640 m), more than 48 of 94 similar developments (the same as 21); nearest hawker centre Tampines Round Market And Food Centre about 1,810 m; nearest park Tampines Eco Green Park about 1,940 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Tampines Round Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Pasir Ris East MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,890 m, under construction; LTA target 2030. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Kassia, 22 new sales, about 1,090 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 33 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 22 new sales and 560 resales (582 purchases); new sales were 3.8% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 560 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 70 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 560 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 729 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−23.2%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
